thesis: India's #2 luggage maker (behind VIP) riding the post-Covid travel boom and premiumization. 44% 5yr sales CAGR, 20% ROCE, zero pledge, 44.7% promoter holding. Kacholia has held 1.84% since Dec-22 through a 47% drawdown — genuine conviction, not momentum-chasing. The stock sits at its 52-week low (Rs 1,318), 28% below DCF fair value (Rs 1,827). The DCF is trustworthy — sane beta (0.81), robust across discount rates (FV Rs 1,350-2,216 at w=9.35-11.75%).
cash_conversion_verdict: The 46.6% 5yr CFO/EBITDA looks alarming but is explainable: sales grew 6.2x (FY21→FY26) while PPE grew 6.8x — this is a manufacturing capacity build, not cash leakage. Borrowings barely rose (Rs 41cr→Rs 117cr) despite Rs 389cr PPE addition; growth is funded from internal accruals. CFO/PAT is 81% (above 80% bar). The lumpy pattern (strong FY24/FY26, weak FY23/FY25) matches working-capital absorption during hypergrowth phases. NOT a fraud signal.
receivables_verdict: The partial-review concern was overstated. Debtor days IMPROVED from 101 (FY21) to 47 (FY26). Receivables grew 190% vs sales 524% since FY21 — growing SLOWER than sales, not faster. Collection is improving as the company scales.
risks: Cash conversion must improve: 46.6% CFO/EBITDA is below the 70% bar. If FY27 doesn't show sustained >60%, revisit the thesis.
Margin volatility: 11.2pp EBITDA margin range over 5yr. Luggage is discretionary — vulnerable in a slowdown.
A5 negative: incremental returns on capital (-2.6%) below cost of capital. The massive capex must start generating returns.
G1 VETOED-DATA (structural D3 gap — same as all 23). G3 unverifiable (no volume data).
No credibility audit yet (C5=1 neutral placeholder). Claude PROMISES run needed.
Competition: VIP Industries is the entrenched leader; Safari is the challenger. Market share gains are not guaranteed.
catalysts: At 52-week low (Rs 1,318) — 0.7% above the low. Mean-reversion setup.
G2 (INV) trigger at Rs 1,143 — 13% below current price. A further dip creates a mechanical entry.
Travel/luggage demand tailwinds: premiumization, brand building, distribution expansion.
Kacholia's continued holding through 47% drawdown signals insider conviction.
